user.title: Connect to Peplink Router
user.description: Your admin login is used once to create an API client named "Home Assistant" on the router. Home Assistant keeps only that client's ID and secret, never your password. Remove the client on the router to revoke access.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to the Peplink router again
reauth_confirm.description: The router no longer accepts Home Assistant's API client at {host} (it may have been removed). Enter an admin login once to create a new one; the password is not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the router
error.ssl_error: SSL certificate validation failed. Try disabling SSL verification.
error.api_client_failed: The router would not create an API client. Use an admin account with read-write access (firmware 7.0 or later).

abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again: Home Assistant now uses a new API client.

settings.title: Peplink settings
settings.description: Configure options for the Peplink integration. Pick the clients you want a device tracker for (for example phones for presence, or devices with no integration of their own). All connected clients are always listed in the Connected Clients sensor.

join_wifi.title: Join Wi-Fi network
join_wifi.description: Joins a network on a Wi-Fi WAN. Pick a network found by the last scan or a saved one, or type a name. Leave the password empty for open and saved networks. The password goes straight to the router, which saves it; Home Assistant keeps no copy. Joining replaces the WAN's current Wi-Fi connection. {scan_hint}

error.network_required: Pick or type a network name.
error.password_required: This network is secured and not saved on the router: enter its password.
error.enterprise_not_supported: Enterprise (802.1x / WPA-EAP) networks must be joined from the router's web page.
error.join_failed: The router rejected the request. Check the log for details.

abort.join_started: Joining {ssid} on {wan}. This takes up to a minute: the WAN's Last Join Result sensor shows Connected, Wrong password, Network not found or Timed out.

join_wifi.name: Join Wi-Fi network
join_wifi.description: Joins a Wi-Fi network on a Peplink Wi-Fi WAN. Target the WAN's Network select. Without an SSID it joins the network chosen in that select. Give the password for a new secured network; the router saves it for next time.

password.name: Password
password.description: Wi-Fi password. Leave empty for open networks and networks the router has already saved.

ssid.name: Network name (SSID)
ssid.description: Network to join. Leave empty to use the one chosen in the Network select.

forget_wifi.name: Forget Wi-Fi network
forget_wifi.description: Deletes a saved Wi-Fi network from the router (and disconnects if it is in use). Target the WAN's Network select.

ssid.name: Network name (SSID)
ssid.description: Network to forget. Leave empty to use the one chosen in the Network select.
